content.comment_body: Hello, When I run a simulation of my program in [product_name] [version_no], my Mac becomes very slow whenever a message window appears. The system freezes more often than it runs my program. Has anyone encountered this issue on MacOS or found a solution?
I found a solution to my issue. I was using an outdated version of Java. After updating to Java 8 (latest version), the problem was resolved.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced significant performance problems while running simulations in [product_name] [version_no] on MacOS, particularly when a message window was open, which caused frequent freezing. These issues were solved by updating Java to a new version, illustrating that compatibility between the application and the Java runtime is crucial for smooth operation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects stable and responsive performance from [product_name] [version_no] on MacOS during simulations, even when message windows are open.
